description: A young girl and her dog venture into a frozen mountain range to perform a mystical ritual. By extracting a glowing spark from a massive stone giant and placing it in her staff, she successfully transforms the winter wasteland into a vibrant spring landscape.

characters.name: Spring Girl
characters.description: A young girl with dark blue braided hair, wearing a red tunic, a dark grey scarf, and carrying a large, gnarled wooden staff.

characters.name: Scruffy Dog
characters.description: A small, scruffy grey dog with a red collar who helps the girl navigate the dangerous terrain.

characters.name: Stone Giants
characters.description: Colossal, multi-legged ancient beings made of rock and ice that inhabit the foggy mountain peaks and transform the land as they move.

threads.description: The girl attempts to perform a magic ritual by harvesting energy from a stone giant to end the eternal winter and bring spring to the valley.
The girl and her dog try to navigate the crumbling, shifting terrain to reach the peak safely as the massive giants awaken and move.

events.description: Close-up shots of frozen plants and icicles establish the harsh, winter environment.
Spring Girl walks across a desolate mountain ridge high above a sea of clouds.
Spring Girl plays with Scruffy Dog, who finds a stick on the path.
Spring Girl and Scruffy Dog walk toward a thick, foggy forest as the terrain becomes more difficult.
The pair enters a frozen forest filled with giant icicles and ancient, stone-like structures.
A massive tremor shakes the ground as the leg of a gargantuan stone giant descends from the fog.
Several colossal stone giants begin to wake and move through the forest, towering over the landscape.
Spring Girl stops to observe the glowing, musical energy pulses moving within the body of a passing giant.
Spring Girl reaches out and successfully captures a glowing blue spirit of spring energy from the stone giant.
The environment collapses and shifts dangerously as the awakened giants move, forcing the girl and dog to flee.
Spring Girl and Scruffy Dog are cornered at a cliff edge as a giant's massive foot looms directly above them.
Spring Girl uses the captured energy to activate her staff, creating a wave of warmth that stops the giant's foot.
The magical energy ripples through the valley, causing the stone giants to transform and release clouds of spring.
The landscape rapidly changes as the ice melts and vibrant flowers begin to bloom across the valley floor.
Spring Girl and Scruffy Dog walk through the now lush, green valley, having successfully brought spring to the land.
The film concludes with the title card and final production credits over a static background.
